import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ars=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/.codex/plugins/cache/ars-codex/ars-codex/0.1.28/skills/academic-research-suite/ars');sys.path.insert(0,str(ars))
from scripts.ars_anchorize_draft import anchorize_text,build_manifest
from scripts._block_parser import parse_document
r=json.loads(Path('BATCH_ROUND10_STAGE4_5_ROUND3_E6_EXACT_RESTORATION_REQUEST.json').read_bytes());rows=[]
for p in r['patches']:
    draft=Path(p['intended_next_draft_path']);raw=draft.read_bytes();text=raw.decode('utf8')
    if anchorize_text(text)!=text:raise RuntimeError('STOP: anchorizer would alter applied draft')
    value=build_manifest(raw,parse_document(text));payload=(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf8')
    target=draft.with_suffix('.block-manifest.json')
    if target.exists():raise RuntimeError('STOP: manifest output exists')
    rows.append({'paper_id':p['paper_id'],'path':str(target),'content':value,'expected_bytes':len(payload),'expected_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'anchorizer_would_change_draft':False})
print(json.dumps({'status':'OFFICIAL_PURE_MANIFESTS_PREPARED_NO_DRAFT_WRITE','rows':rows}))
